//: Config for the Vercel serverless function(s). @vercel/node resolves this by walking up from the entrypoint, so it is used INSTEAD of the frontend tsconfig. It extends the shared base (no `noEmit`, no `allowImportingTsExtensions`) so @vercel/node can emit the function. module/moduleResolution are overridden to nodenext (not the base's bundler) to mirror how @vercel/node builds the ESM function, so this local typecheck catches missing-.js-extension errors (TS2835) instead of only surfacing them on Vercel.
